title: EDE published legislation catalogue
summary: Official index includes federal legislation governing medical products and a national essential medicines list. The index alone does not establish permission for an inter-hospital transfer.

title: EDE multiple authorized commercial agents mechanism, 24 February 2026
summary: EDE announced activation of a mechanism requiring companies to appoint more than one authorized commercial agent for each medical product marketed in the UAE. These are commercial agents, not AI agents.

title: WHO Model List of Essential Medicines, 24th edition (2025)
summary: WHO maintains an essential medicines model list to guide country priorities. It is not a permit to distribute or substitute any specific product.

title: EMA Voluntary Solidarity Mechanism for critical shortages
summary: A voluntary mechanism supports countries seeking assistance during exceptional critical shortages. Its procedures are not binding in the UAE.

title: AI for Good Lab Hackathon UAE 2026 — evaluation criteria
summary: Official 2026 UAE hackathon evaluation requires national knowledge base, agent scenarios, global policy examples, evidence logs and Y.3172/AI readiness mapping.

title: ITU-T Y.3172 architectural framework (2019)
summary: Describes ML pipeline, function orchestration and sandbox for future networks. MedRoute is an architectural analogy, not Y.3172 certification.

title: UAE Charter for the Development and Use of Artificial Intelligence
summary: The official charter overview emphasizes responsible AI, privacy, safety, fairness, transparency, accountability and compliance with applicable law. Source is a policy overview, not product-specific approval.

title: National Cyber Security Policy for Artificial Intelligence
summary: The official overview covers AI operational safety, secure ML asset lifecycle, monitoring, resilience and human oversight in critical decisions. Full downloadable text is not bundled.

title: UAE cyber laws catalogue (including Federal Decree-Law No 45 of 2021 on personal data protection)
summary: Official cyber laws catalogue identifies the federal personal data protection law. The index does not establish applicability, exemptions or permitted processing for a specific inter-hospital exchange.

title: UAE International Stance on Artificial Intelligence Policy
summary: Government portal describes principles of progress, collaboration, community, ethics, sustainability and safety for AI in international governance. Not binding medical distribution authorization.

title: Federal Decree-Law No. 38 of 2024 Governing Medical Products, Pharmacists and Pharmaceutical Establishments
summary: Official UAE legislation portal lists this law as active, issued 1 October 2024 and effective 2 January 2025. English text is informational; the original Arabic prevails in case of conflict. No product-specific transfer authorization has been established by this metadata review.

title: Approve Emergency Drugs and Psychotropic Materials — EDE service
summary: Official EDE service for requesting approval of emergency transfers of narcotic, psychotropic and semi-controlled medicines between eligible health facilities. Lists facility/director justification, licences, NOC, transferor import permit and patient-related supporting documents. Approval is issued by EDE, not by this simulator.

title: Federal Law No. 2 of 2019 on the Use of Information and Communications Technology in Health Fields
summary: Official English translation, Articles 4, 13 and 16: health-data confidentiality and restricted circulation; rules for health-data processing outside UAE; patient confidentiality with enumerated exceptions. Applicability and Arabic original require qualified review. MedRoute accepts no real patient data.

title: EDE announcement on multiple authorised agents for medical products (24 February 2026)
summary: EDE announced activation of a mechanism requiring more than one authorised agent for each medical product marketed in UAE, referring to Federal Decree-Law No. 38 of 2024. News announcement only; legal text, scope, implementation and exceptions need expert review. Not a hospital transfer permission.
